<%*
const num  = await tp.system.prompt("Task id: nn)");
const name = await tp.system.prompt("Task name: alphanum-alphanum");

if (!num || !name) { new Notice("Operation canceled."); return; }

const id    = "TASK-" + num.padStart(2, "0");
const folder = "backlog/" + id + "-" + name;
const title  = name.replace(/-/g, " ");
const today  = tp.date.now("YYYY-MM-DD");
const fence  = String.fromCharCode(96).repeat(3);

await tp.file.move(folder + "/task");

const requirements = [
  "---",
  "id: " + id,
  "doc: requirements",
  "updated: " + today,
  "---",
  "",
  "# " + id + ": Requirements",
  "",
  "← [[task|Back to the task]]",
  "",
  "## Context",
  "",
  "Why is this task needed, which problem does it solve, and under what conditions.",
  "",
  "## Functional requirements",
  "",
  "### FR-1: Requirement's name",
  "",
  "Description: what the applicaton should do.",
  "",
  "**Acceptance criteria:**",
  "- [ ] Criteria 1",
  "- [ ] Criteria 2",
  "",
  "## Limitations and assumptions",
  "",
  "- **Limitation:**",
  "- **Assumption:**",
  "",
  "## Out of scope",
  "",
  "- "
].join("\n");

const design = [
  "---",
  "id: " + id,
  "doc: design",
  "updated: " + today,
  "---",
  "",
  "# " + id + ": Design",
  "",
  "← [[task|Back to the task]] | [[requirements]]",
  "",
  "## Solution overview",
  "",
  "In one paragraph: the approach chosen and why it was chosen.",
  "",
  "## Architecture",
  "",
  fence + "mermaid",
  "graph TD",
  "    A[Component A] --> B[Component B]",
  fence,
  "",
  "## Key decisions",
  "",
  "### Decision 1: Decision name",
  "",
"**Context:** What problem are we solving?",
"**Options:** Option A / Option B",
"**Choice:** Option A because...",
"",
"## Interfaces",
"",
"### API",
  "",
  fence,
  "POST /api/resource",
  "Body: { field: string }",
  "Response: { id: string, status: string }",
  fence,
  "",
  "### Data model",
  "",
  fence,
  "Entity { id: UUID, field: string }",
  fence,
  "",
"## Impact on the existing system",
  "",
"## Open questions",
  "",
  "- [ ] Open questions 1"
].join("\n");

const plan = [
  "---",
  "id: " + id,
  "doc: plan",
  "updated: " + today,
  "---",
  "",
"# " + id + ": Implementation Plan",
"",
"← [[task|Back to task]] | [[design|Design]]",
"",
"## Stages",
"",
"### Stage 1: Title",
"",
"**Goal:** What will be ready upon completion of this stage.",
"",
"- [ ] Step 1.1",
"- [ ] Step 1.2",
"",
"---",
"",
"### Stage 2: Testing",
"",
"- [ ] Unit Tests",
"- [ ] Manual AC Check: FR-1, FR-2",
"",
"## Risks",
"",
"| Risk | Probability | Impact | Mitigation |",
"|------|------------|----------|------------|",
"| | | | |",
"",
"## Definition of Done",
"",
"- [ ] All plan steps completed",
"- [ ] All acceptance criteria passed",
"- [ ] Code passed review",
"- [ ] Status in task.md updated to done"
].join("\n");

await tp.file.create_new(requirements, "requirements", false, folder);
await tp.file.create_new(design,       "design",       false, folder);
await tp.file.create_new(plan,         "plan",         false, folder);

tR += [
  "---",
  "id: " + id,
  'title: "' + title + '"',
  "status: todo",
  "priority: medium",
  "size: M",
  "created: " + today,
  "tags: []",
  "---",
  "",
  "# " + id + ": " + title,
  "",
  "## Description",
  "",
  "In one paragraph: what and why should be done.",
  "",
"## Related Documents",
"",
"- [[requirements]] — requirements and acceptance criteria",
"- [[design]] — architectural solution",
"- [[plan]] — implementation plan",
"",
"## Dependencies",
"",
"- Depends on: <!-- [[TASK-XX]] -->",
"- Blocks: <!-- [[TASK-XX]] -->",
"",
"## Notes",
"",
"<!-- Short operational notes, decisions made on the fly -->"
].join("\n");
%>
